title: The Lamp of the Ages
how_1: Turn the time dial to a century, then pick a lit place on the map: the lamp takes you there.
how_2: At each place, meet a figure from the museum's records, answer one question from what the records say, and take a record card with you.
how_3: Some ways open only when you carry a certain card. Figures you have met may travel with you, two at a time.
jinni_1: In the folk tale of 'Ala al-Din and the lamp, first printed in Antoine Galland's French Thousand and One Nights in 1710, a jinni of the lamp serves whoever holds it.
jinni_2: Here the jinni is only a guide who opens the way. The journey is fiction and makes no claim about the unseen; what you see in each place comes from the museum's sourced records.
jinni_link: What the museum records about the jinn in Islamic belief
review_note: Historical review pending: the records shown here are the museum's sourced records, not yet reviewed by a named historian.
